notes.title: PATCH 1.1 & STEAM AUTUMN SALE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey people! 
We just released patch 1.1 for Aokana and the Steam Autumn Sale is currently live![/b][/h1]
[b][list]
[*] Added Voice line Bookmarks
[*] Added asset prefetch for a better reading experience
[*] Added multithreading
[*] Added various performance improvements
[*] Fixed several bugs and typos
[/list][/b]

You can find the Voice line bookmark button ingame at the top of the menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/0bf87077a0bb411aee3bc6cc0ae62febba9880c0.jpg[/img]

Clicking it will bring up the extra menu where you will be able to save the voice line.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/af08d6e12e00894e0fe15f78b9cb29bcd502d4fd.jpg[/img]

You can always open the extra menu from the main menu by clicking on "Extra."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/7cce120fc63dc84417464b54e7645988da34af80.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/NekoNyanLtd]Also, the Steam Autumn Sale is currently live and our whole catalog of games is discounted right now so take a look![/url]
